label: high at D2 when S1 reached; at D1/GO high after reward, after a2, S2-leaning belief
terms: (phase == D2) * (state == S1) ;; (phase != D2) * np.clip(belief_lo,-5,5) ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_action == 2) ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_reward == 1) ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (prev_state == S2) ;; (phase != D2) * (prev_reward == 0) * (tv("prev_reward", -1) == 0) ;; (phase == D2) * np.clip(belief_lo,-5,5) * (state == S1)
explanation: Raw reset gate r of unit 18. Timing alone gives R^2 0.71 (D1 ~0.74 > GO ~0.63 > D2 ~0.29). Beyond timing, two observed-only regimes. D2: the reached state dominates; reaching S1 raises r by ~+0.29 relative to S2 (slightly less when belief already favours S1). D1/GO: r goes up after a rewarded previous trial (+0.15), after an unrewarded trial that ended in S2 (+0.09), and after choosing a2 (+0.04); it goes down with the ideal-observer belief that S1 is good (-0.023 per log-odds unit) and after two unrewarded trials in a row (-0.03). Taken together, at D1/GO the unit is higher when the observed history points to a2/S2, which is a stand-in for the upcoming choice (that choice x state cue reaches 0.72 on its own). Seven observed-only terms: test R^2 beyond timing 0.861 (dev 0.85-0.86), 92% of the all ceiling 0.94 and close to the all-observed ceiling 0.90. Dropping the model value/policy costs little: policy decile alone scores 0.48, and the observed history plus belief recover nearly all of what it carried. Remaining misses: long runs of unrewarded a2->S1-rare trials are over-predicted at D1/GO.

issues: Reproduced test R^2 beyond timing 0.8614 with weights matching the explanation (D2 S1 +0.292, belief_lo -0.023, prev a2 +0.040, prev rewarded +0.151, prev unrewarded in S2 +0.090, two unrewarded in a row -0.032, D2 belief x S1 -0.016).
Most of the score comes from D1/GO history and belief. The D2 state term alone scores only 0.28, so 'the reached state dominates' is true within D2 only, not of the whole fit.

Some of the claimed effects are small. Removing prev_action==2 costs about 0.010 (0.852). Removing the two-unrewarded term costs 0.004 (0.858). Removing the D2 belief x S1 interaction costs 0.017 (0.845). Belief is the important D1/GO term: without it the score drops to 0.771.
'+0.09 after unrewarded S2' only holds with belief in the model. In the raw residual table, a1 S2 u is -0.14 at D1 while a2 S2 u is +0.03. The label's single-effect wording hides this.

The misses output shows the reported failure: runs of a2->S1 rare unrewarded trials are over-predicted by about 0.15-0.23 at GO and D2. Other cell errors are moderate (largest |mean error| 0.07, at GO after a1 S2 r; D1 after a1 S1 u is -0.054). Mean errors by phase are about 0.

None of my extra terms moved test R^2 by more than about 0.001: run-of-unrewarded count, the a2-S1-rare streak, belief x prev_action, belief_cover weighting, a GO-specific belief term, prev rare-rewarded, a D2 rare-transition term, and a saturating belief shape. The best was 0.8626. The remaining gap to the observed-only ceiling of 0.90 has no simple fix.
